{{Top|notoc=1}}
{{Youmay|an award given called a bounty|other uses of [[Bounty (disambiguation)|bounty]]}}
{{Youmayredirect|Bounty #239|the Bith criminal|Bounty 239}}
[[File:CadBaneposter.jpg|thumb|right|150px|A wanted poster for [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]], using the [[High Galactic/Legends|High Galactic alphabet]]]]
{{Quote|Well, there's a price on my head. If I don't pay off Jabba the Hutt, I'm a dead man.''"<br />"''A death mark's not an easy thing to live with.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[General/Legends|General]] [[Carlist Rieekan/Legends|Carlist Rieekan]]|<ref name="Episode 5">{{Film|V}}</ref>}}
A '''bounty''' was a monetary reward given when someone was captured or [[Death/Legends|killed]] for a client. One who fulfilled bounties for a living was known as a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]]. Many bounty hunters worked for [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lords]] such as [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] and [[Tyber Zann]].

The word was used informally to refer to the payment for a service, particularly in the case of finding a missing person.<ref name="cp">{{LivingForce|Clouds of Genarius: Clouded Paths}}</ref> Often, bounties were more profitable when they required physical risk to complete. Bounty hunting was a fundamental part of many cultures, such as that of the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodians]] and the [[Gand/Legends|Gand]] [[Findsman/Legends|findsmen]].

Bounties were sometimes categorized into local bounties, [[Star system/Legends|system]] bounties, [[Sector/Legends|sector]] bounties and regional bounties. Submission of a valid [[B23-1-14 permit]] enabled a bounty hunter to collect the maximum profit.

[[File:SavageOpressBounty-Revenge.png|thumb|right|150px|A holographic bounty for [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] on a device on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].]]
Depending on the jurisdiction, a person without a permit could earn a bounty, as was the norm in [[Lamaredd/Legends|Lamaredd]].<ref name="R">{{GamerCite|7|Reckonings}}</ref>

The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] bounty system of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] era allowed two types of bounties to be posted; public and private, the latter making the poster anonymous, though it could be accessed by someone carrying a bounty [[Hunting/Legends|hunting]] license.

During the Imperial Era, [[Imperial Peace-Keeping Certificate/Legends|Imperial Peace-Keeping Certificates]] were issued to licensed bounty hunters, and were presumably required for hunters of the era to be hired legally. Many "hunters", however, worked for criminal elements, such as the [[Kajidic/Legends|Hutt clans]], and it is reasonable to assume that they ignored such attempts at regulation.
